Subject: Roundtable planning: evening APAC-friendly slots and host rotation

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick sync earlier. We'd like to run a 60–90 minute multi-company roundtable/demo to show a couple of short walkthroughs (20 min each) + Q&A and a lightweight product roadmap preview. Goal is to make this convenient for APAC-based dev/infra teams while still working for NA.

Proposed approach (pick one option):
- Option A: Single 75-minute block (19:30–20:45 IST / 07:00–08:15 PDT) on Wed 13 Jul — prefer this if we want a single bridge and full Q&A.
- Option B: Two 45-minute blocks back-to-back (Block 1: 18:45–19:30 IST / Block 2: 19:30–20:15 IST) to reduce meeting fatigue; we can rotate hosts across blocks.

Things we need from internal team:
- Host coverage for both blocks (Ben + Marissa?)
- One backup presenter who can step in if we need to switch models mid-demo
- A short pre-demo checklist (network/firewall notes) to share with prospects

Emily / Jordan / Kai — any hard constraints on the evening windows above? If you prefer, call out a specific timezone and local time that works and we’ll map it. I’ve attached a draft agenda and a calendar placeholder.

Attachments: roundtable-agenda.pdf, calendar-placeholder.ics

Next step: If I don’t hear objections, I’ll tentatively reserve the bridge for Wed 13 Jul and circulate final invites by end of week.

—Rafael
